questions.question: According to the chapter, what is the ethical way to use AI tools for schoolwork?
options: Use AI for explanations and feedback while writing your own work
Have AI write the assignment and submit it as your own
Only use AI to translate finished Norwegian texts
questions.explanation: Using AI to learn — getting explanations, feedback and practice — is ethical; submitting AI-written work as your own is not.

questions.question: Which type of digital tool is best suited for vocabulary drills and habit formation?
questions.explanation: Learning apps are designed for vocabulary, grammar drills and building daily study habits.

questions.question: What principle is more effective for learning through digital media?
options: Watching as many videos as possible without notes
Avoiding authentic content until you are fluent
Using only one tool for everything
questions.explanation: Actively engaging with content — noting expressions, practising, producing language — beats passive watching.

questions.question: What is a sensible use of translation tools in language learning?
options: Support for comprehension and individual words
Replacing the need to learn vocabulary
questions.explanation: Translation tools work best as comprehension support for words and phrases — not for producing whole assignments.

questions.question: Why do media platforms like streaming services help language learning?
options: They provide authentic listening practice and natural expressions
questions.explanation: Authentic films, series and podcasts expose you to natural language, accents and expressions in real contexts.
